snippet.title: Gentle Hands! 🐱 Allah Loves Gentleness | Islam for Kids #shorts
snippet.description:
Whoa, slow down! The kitty is scared of rough hands!

Our Prophet Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) said: "Allah is gentle, and He loves gentleness."

So let's use gentle hands: stroke the kitty soft and slow, help little sister build her tower higher instead of knocking it down, close the door softly and pass the plate gently. When we are gentle, Allah gives us so much good!

Source
• Sahih Muslim 2593 (narrated by Hazrat Aisha, Radi Allahu Anha): https://sunnah.com/muslim:2593

Masjid-e-Nabawi footage: muhammadarhamamin77800 on Pixabay (https://pixabay.com/videos/id-198164/)

We never show any Prophet or Companion. Only an ordinary family is drawn.
For ages 3 to 9 · Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at
